snippet.title: CivCrafter | Strategy Clicker for iOS and Android
snippet.description:
iOS - http://itunes.apple.com/app/id894778729?at=10laCF&ct=youtube
Google Play - http://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.naquatic.civclicker
Amazon - http://www.amazon.com/gp/mas/dl/android?p=com.naquatic.civclicker&tag=nall06-20

Craft an entire civilization with a single finger! 

"The deepest clicker game yet" - Touch Arcade 
"The most addictive mobile game we have ever played. Period" - Free Apps Arcade

• YOUR KINGDOM AWAITS • 
Gather resources, build an army, and battle clans for world supremacy. Will you be a benevolent ruler or a vicious tyrant? The choice is yours!
